name: MiniCPM-OCR 1.0

lineage.how_derived: trained for OCR on top of MiniCPM-V 4.6; DSpark draft model and a separate Jev correctness model released alongside

purpose: First OCR-specific model of the MiniCPM-V/o family: text-centric document understanding (text, tables, formulas, charts, seals, key information extraction) balancing quality and speed on real-world captures (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; the HF repo has no LICENSE file, the Apache-2.0 text was read in the GitHub repo OpenBMB/MiniCPM-OCR. The full-page pipeline also uses the PP-DocLayoutV3 layout model (PaddlePaddle), whose license was not checked.

architecture.kind: vision-language: SigLIP encoder + Qwen3.5-style hybrid language model (config text_config: 24 layers, one full-attention layer in four, linear attention in between)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, linear (gated DeltaNet-style) in between, per config full_attention_interval 4

pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

engine_support.notes: Card: vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp and Ollama from day one. Full-page parsing is a two-stage pipeline: PP-DocLayoutV3 layout detection in the SDK, then region recognition by the model over HTTP.

benchmarks.name: throughput on RTX 5090, OmniDocBench v1.6, concurrency 1
throughput relative to PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 / MinerU2.5 Pro

strengths: 1.3B: the smallest strong document parser found, official GGUF down to 0.5 GB
weaknesses: primary languages are Chinese and English only (card); German not stated
needs an external layout model for full pages, so it is a pipeline rather than one end-to-end model
soft.maturity: OpenBMB family with day-one llama.cpp support; 243k downloads of the main repo

tona_fit.reason: Excellent size and license, but the card lists Chinese and English only; for German documents a model with German evidence (Chandra-class, or the WeVisDoc models) is the better first pick. Becomes a candidate if a German page benchmark appears.
blockers: needs a layout detector for full pages

open_questions: German and other European language quality
builder's reasons for the Qwen3.5 hybrid backbone
license of the PP-DocLayoutV3 layout model used by the pipeline
